sources.name: Stitch - A guide to South African payment rails

entries.subject: capitec_pay_feature_fee
entries.display: Capitec Pay costs R1.00 per payment
entries.notes: Capitec Pay is Capitec's proprietary bank payment API, listed under purchases in the fee schedule.

entries.subject: ewallet_otp_validity
entries.display: eWallet withdrawal OTP is valid for 16 hours
entries.quote: You will receive a One Time PIN (OTP) and sometimes a reference number, depending on where you choose to withdraw from (the OTP is valid for 16 hours).
entries.notes: Page undated; captured 2026-11-02. Source page undated; effective date recorded as the 2026-11-02 capture date.

entries.subject: ewallet_cash_collection_points
entries.display: eWallet cash can be collected at an ATM, AgencyPlus or a shop
entries.quote: Select 'At ATM or AgencyPlus' or 'At Shop' and tap Continue
entries.notes: WhatsApp 'Get Cash' flow. Source page undated; effective date recorded as the 2026-11-02 capture date.

entries.subject: ewallet_fuel_station_purchase
entries.display: eWallet funds can be spent at selected Engen, Shell, Sasol and TotalEnergies stations
entries.quote: Make a purchase at selected Engen, Shell, Sasol, and TotalEnergies fuel stations
entries.notes: Source page undated; effective date recorded as the 2026-11-02 capture date.

entries.subject: ewallet_ussd_send_channel
entries.display: eWallet can be sent over cellphone banking (USSD) as well as the app, online banking and WhatsApp
entries.notes: USSD string for FNB cellphone banking eWallet send flow. Source page undated; effective date recorded as the 2026-11-02 capture date.

entries.subject: payshap_participation_statement
entries.display: PayShap is available at participating banks only, with more banks being added
entries.quote: PayShap is available at participating banks, with more banks coming on board soon.
entries.notes: Scheme's own site; page undated, captured 2026-11-02. Source page undated; effective date recorded as the 2026-11-02 capture date.

entries.subject: payshap_request_launch
entries.quote: This service launched in December 2024 and allows payees (individuals, businesses or informal traders) to request immediate payment from payers across any participating bank.
entries.notes: Industry explainer, not a scheme rulebook.

entries.subject: shapid_proxy_identifier
entries.display: A ShapID is a proxy identifier (mobile number or ShapName) that replaces the account number
entries.quote: they can instead use their associated mobile number or a unique business name (ShapName) as a proxy identifier, referred to as a ShapID

entries.subject: snapscan_hardware_requirement
entries.display: SnapScan merchants need no additional hardware - a QR code is displayed or downloaded
entries.quote: Download a digital QR Code from your Merchant Portal or buy a QR Code stand from our online store.
entries.notes: A printed stand is optional; the QR code can be displayed digitally. Source page undated; effective date recorded as the 2026-11-02 capture date. [normalised: categorical answer, grade with quote]

entries.subject: snapscan_onboarding_steps
entries.display: SnapScan merchant onboarding is four steps: sign up, verify, choose solutions, get paid
entries.quote: 1 Sign up Create an account and tell us about your business 2 Verify Upload the required documents to get the legal stuff sorted 3 Choose solutions Select which of our solutions are best for your business 4 Get paid Start accepting payments quickly and easily - anytime, anywhere.
entries.notes: Source page undated; effective date recorded as the 2026-11-02 capture date.

entries.subject: gotyme_no_internet_banking
entries.display: GoTyme Bank (formerly TymeBank) no longer offers internet banking; accounts are run in the app and at kiosks
entries.quote: To make your banking as convenient and secure as possible, we're moving all your account management into the GoTyme Bank app and kiosks. Internet banking is no longer available.
entries.notes: Page undated; captured 2026-11-02. Source page undated; effective date recorded as the 2026-11-02 capture date.

entries.subject: open_banking_apis_live
entries.display: Three bank payment APIs are live: Capitec Pay, Absa Pay and Nedbank Direct EFT
entries.quote: The three live open banking APIs in the South African market are Capitec Pay, Absa Pay and Nedbank Direct EFT - all of which are available through Stitch.
entries.notes: Industry explainer; count may change over time.

notes: Product facts are drawn from bank pages (Capitec, FNB, GoTyme), the PayShap scheme site and SnapScan. Where a page was captured without dated content the effective date is left null and confidence is set accordingly.
